data.narrative:
Orbital Inc. is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Euwyn Poon that has raised an undisclosed amount via a16z Speedrun. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though the narrow peer set for Seed-stage companies in this sector is limited.

A Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach given data constraints. Using a $16M proxy based on total raised and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $40M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable—while 14 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 occupy the same stage or adjacent valuation tier, making narrow-set comparison unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring also cannot be applied; though the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 25.3x P/S across the 5 public tickers, Orbital's revenue is not on file, as is typical for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M to $46M, centered at $40M. Key uncertainties include the actual total capital raised (undisclosed), Orbital's revenue or ARR trajectory, and the applicability of public-market multiples to an unfunded private Seed company. The single-method foundation warrants caution; validation would require either disclosure of revenue metrics or identification of additional adjacent-stage private comparable transactions.
